co_pagosa_springs.name: Pagosa Springs
co_pagosa_springs.note: No climbing source names months; only generic weather inference (roughly May-Oct).

ar_lake_lincoln.name: Lake Lincoln
ar_lake_lincoln.note: Lake Lincoln listing names every month; only a statewide guide says mid-Sep to mid-May. No area-specific agreement.

az_7_upper_highway.name: Upper Highway
az_7_upper_highway.note: Sources say spring and fall, winter too cold/snowbound; no month-naming climbing source for this crag.

oh_chippewa_creek.name: Chippewa Creek
oh_chippewa_creek.note: Spring and fall / fall through spring only; no months. Climbing here is also reported prohibited by Cleveland Metroparks.

ut_kane_springs_canyon.name: Kane Springs Canyon
ut_kane_springs_canyon.note: Moab guide names March to early May and Sep-Oct; MP/other say spring and fall best, summer too hot. Winter possible but not counted.

wi_west_bluff_central.name: West Bluff Central
wi_west_bluff_central.note: Only KAYA (Devil's Lake generally) names fall Sep-Nov; no second source for the West Bluff.

id_swan_falls.name: Swan Falls
id_swan_falls.note: Spring, fall and winter named as words; no months; midsummer too hot.

nc_1_southern_mountains_region.name: Southern Mountains Region
nc_1_southern_mountains_region.note: Region-wide; sources about Looking Glass only (fall/winter vs fall/spring disagree). Too broad to set.

ca_central_pinnacles.name: Central Pinnacles
ca_central_pinnacles.note: Spring and fall at ~7,500 ft; summer shade, winter sunny days; no months named.

co_east_animas.name: East Animas
co_east_animas.note: Spring and fall per MP and Durango.org; no months named.

co_thunder_ridge.name: Thunder Ridge
co_thunder_ridge.note: Only ClimbingAway names Jan-Apr; no second source (south-facing walls only suggest cool months).

ny_central_park.name: Central Park
ny_central_park.note: Single source lists Jan-Aug (odd); no second confirmation.

tn_walden_s_ridge_park.name: Walden's Ridge Park
tn_walden_s_ridge_park.note: Only a hint to wait for cooler temps; no months.

oh_whipps_ledges.name: Whipps Ledges
oh_whipps_ledges.note: No climbing season text found; permit-only site.

az_superstition_mountains.name: Superstition Mountains
az_superstition_mountains.note: One source Oct-May, another Oct-Apr; took shared Oct-Apr; summer avoided.

bc_stawamus_chief.name: Stawamus Chief
bc_stawamus_chief.note: June-Sep driest; late May-Sep best weather; May-June good; early fall ok; winter wet. Sources are travel-oriented.

mi_wetmore_landing.name: Wetmore Landing
mi_wetmore_landing.note: No months found; only spring-through-fall for a different Marquette crag.

wa_icicle_creek.name: Icicle Creek
wa_icicle_creek.note: One guide: best rock April-Nov; others: late spring-early fall, crisp fall days good, aspect-dependent in summer.

nv_first_creek_canyon.name: First Creek Canyon
nv_first_creek_canyon.note: Red Rocks system: Oct-early Apr and Nov-Mar prime with Apr/Oct shoulders; shady higher trad canyons like Pine Creek favour Oct/Apr and warmer days. Canyon-specific text not found.

nv_pine_creek_canyon.name: Pine Creek Canyon
nv_pine_creek_canyon.note: Red Rocks system: Oct-early Apr and Nov-Mar prime with Apr/Oct shoulders; shady higher trad canyons like Pine Creek favour Oct/Apr and warmer days. Canyon-specific text not found.
